findings.scenario: Profile prepare fails with stale version, but profileSnapshot remains populated. After explicit Check account recovery, action check is enabled with the known-stale version. A confirmed profile update likewise leaves the previous version active for the next edit, guaranteeing another stale attempt until user happens to refresh version.
findings.repair: Invalidate captured profileSnapshot on failed profile preparation and terminal confirmed/reverted profile result, without deleting user bio/avatar draft or saved prepared/unknown intent. Require explicit version check before a new profile prepare; retain original saved version during recovery. Add tests for failure then recovery and confirmed action then new edit; no silent reread.
